dog.description_text:
🐾🏈 MEET THOR — SMALL BUT MIGHTY, WITH A HEART OF GOLD! 🏈🐾
❤️ LOOKING FOR HIS FOREVER HOME! ❤️
Meet THOR, an adorable little Pittie mix with a BIG personality and an even BIGGER heart! This handsome little guy may only weigh 4 pounds, but don't let his tiny size fool you!
🐶 Male | Pittie Mix | 8 Weeks Old at Transport | 4 lbs
💕 Confident & Outgoing! Thor isn't afraid to stand up for himself! He's got a little spunk and knows how to hold his own.
🥰 A Total Marshmallow! Underneath that confident personality is the sweetest little cuddle bug! Thor absolutely LOVES being held, snuggling in your lap, and soaking up all the affection he can get.
🐾 Playful & Smart! Thor loves to play, explore, and discover new things. He's a clever little guy who is already showing how quickly he can learn!
🏡 Working on Potty Training! Thor is making progress with housebreaking and is starting to catch on! With patience, consistency, and lots of praise, he'll keep learning those important puppy manners.
❤️ An All-Around GREAT Guy! Thor has the perfect combination of confidence, playfulness, intelligence, and sweetness. He's ready to bring endless love, laughter, and puppy kisses to one very lucky family!

❤️ Interested in making Thor part of your family?
Please submit your adoption application BEFORE attending the event!
🐾 APPLY HERE:
https://form.jotform.com/251046251688156
💕 Thor may be tiny, but the love he has to give is HUGE! Could you be his forever family?
Please SHARE and help this sweet little guy find the loving home he deserves!
dog.name: Thor
